        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_send_additional_readings</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="lane-mpone" name="MPON">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_examine_mpone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_1" name="Start" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_bill" name="Which bill?" />

    <bpmn:task id="T_send_temp_meter" name="Send the bill for the temporary continuation of the metering point operations" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_examine_go_1" name="Examine the bill" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_send_temp_measurement" name="Send the bill for the temporary continuation of the measurement" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_examine_go_2" name="Examine the bill" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_send_additional_readings" name="Send the bill for additional readings" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_examine_go_3" name="Examine the bill" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_send_equipment" name="Send the bill for the equipment acquisition" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_examine_mpone" name="Examine the bill" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_merge" name="Bill examined" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_decision" name="Confirm or reject?" default="F_reject" />

    <bpmn:task id="T_confirm" name="Confirm the invoice with payment advice" />
    <bpmn:task id="T_reject" name="Reject the invoice" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_confirmed" name="Invoice confirmed" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_rejected" name="Invoice rejected" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_start" sourceRef="Start_1" targetRef="G_bill" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b1" name="MPOO sends bill for temporary continuation of metering point operations" sourceRef="G_bill" targetRef="T_send_temp_meter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b1x" sourceRef="T_send_temp_meter" targetRef="T_examine_go_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b1m" sourceRef="T_examine_go_1" targetRef="G_merge" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b2" name="MSPO sends bill for temporary continuation of the measurement" sourceRef="G_bill" targetRef="T_send_temp_measurement" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b2x" sourceRef="T_send_temp_measurement" targetRef="T_examine_go_2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b2m" sourceRef="T_examine_go_2" targetRef="G_merge" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b3" name="MSPO sends bill for additional readings" sourceRef="G_bill" targetRef="T_send_additional_readings" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b3x" sourceRef="T_send_additional_readings" targetRef="T_examine_go_3" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b3m" sourceRef="T_examine_go_3" targetRef="G_merge" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b4" name="MPOO sends bill for the equipment acquisition" sourceRef="G_bill" targetRef="T_send_equipment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b4x" sourceRef="T_send_equipment" targetRef="T_examine_mpone" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_b4m" sourceRef="T_examine_mpone" targetRef="G_merge" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_merge" sourceRef="G_merge" targetRef="G_decision" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_confirm" name="confirm" sourceRef="G_decision" targetRef="T_confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_reject" name="reject" sourceRef="G_decision" targetRef="T_reject" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_c_end" sourceRef="T_confirm" targetRef="End_confirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_r_end" sourceRef="T_reject" targetRef="End_rejected" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
